profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
NextJS , React, Typescript,  GraphQL, React Query, Tachyons, Stylus,  Test Cafe, React Testing Library, Jest, Mocha, Enzyme, i18n

young.renwick.dev@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I have led multiple cross-functional initiatives, driving project success and meeting deadlines across various teams including backend services, iOS, Android, and analytics. Working closely with UX and Product teams, I have contributed to the development of responsive, scalable, and ADA-compliant features. By optimizing GraphQL schemas, I have significantly reduced front-end bundle size and improved performance, resulting in enhanced page load times and a better user experience.

I have excelled at breaking down complex feature work into manageable tasks, accurately estimating completion dates, and ensuring timely delivery. Moreover, I have successfully implemented internationalization (i18n) on the web front-end, enhancing user experience for diverse audiences.

Throughout my career, I have taken pride in my ability to onboard and mentor teammates, fostering their professional growth and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Skills: Next.js · I18n · GraphQL · React Query · Tachyons · TestCafe · Jest · React Testing Library · ReactJS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I have made significant contributions to the migration of the walmart.com/list page to Next.js, harnessing its powerful features to achieve improved performance and an enhanced user experience. Through a meticulous re-architecture process, I implemented a modular and scalable structure, enabling seamless integration of new changes and accommodating multiple variations of the page.

In addition to my technical achievements, I have played a crucial role in mentoring my teammates, guiding them through the Next.js migration and supporting the implementation of the new architecture.

Furthermore, I have demonstrated leadership by successfully overseeing the end-to-end execution of the walmart.com/list/back-to-school initiative. This involved ensuring its seamless integration into the website, contributing to its overall success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I successfully implemented and deployed the sitewide Fashion initiative, seamlessly integrating it across the entire website. I played a crucial role in this initiative by creating reusable components that promoted consistency, code efficiency, and ease of maintenance. By leveraging best practices for component architecture and design patterns, I ensured a robust and cohesive user interface throughout the website.

During this project, I closely collaborated with the UX and Product teams to understand requirements and effectively implement the Fashion initiative. I conducted thorough testing and optimization of the implemented components, guaranteeing a seamless user experience and high performance.

Furthermore, I actively maintained and updated the reusable component library to accommodate evolving design needs and enhance code reusability.

Skills: Redux.js, Stylus, Mocha, Enzyme, ReactJS

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer (via Caspex)
positions.description: Skills: ReactJS · Enzyme · Mocha · Redux.js · Stylus

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Crafted responsive end-of-game modal to display user score, lives, and progress using JavaScript, ReactJS, CoffeeScript, Ruby on Rails, and Sass.
● Built admin dashboard to monitor site statistics (number of new users, total games played per month, etc.) using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Ruby ChartKick, and Sass, decrease time to look up key metrics by 80%.
● Developed page header to enable 1,600+ users to track live progress during instrument learning games built with JavaScript and ReactJS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Constructed comparison tool utilizing JavaScript, jQuery, Ruby on Rails and Slim for users compare multiple coding schools, decreasing visitor bounce rates by 10%.
● Implemented search bar and favorited schools drop down menu for users to add schools for comparison using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Slim, CSS3, and ngrok.
● Engineered favoriting feature to allow for saving of schools to user accounts which minimized user lookup time of schools by more than 50% utilizing Ruby on Rails, Ruby ChartKick and CSS3.

positions.title: Quote Proposal Coordinator
positions.description:
● Reduced quoting turnaround time by over 25% through developing new quoting process using optimized SQL queries and Microsoft Excel with VBA.
● Optimized data queries for other business units with Kinaxis using PostgreSQL database, minimizing manual report generation time by 12X (from 1 hour to 5 mins).

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
● Designed and created new export compliance process, using NetSuite Saved Search (PSQL), which ensured 100% compliance and reduced international shipment downtime by 50%.
● Enhanced user experience by performing quality assurance tests on new code development and participated in scrum agile development methodology using using Atlassian Jira.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
● Collaborated on team of 20 to implement Magento and NetSuite integration, increasing shipment delivery productivity by more than 90%.
● Managed implementation of custom PHP warehousing software which optimized warehousing pick-and-pack time by at least 5X.
